title: RoomsContent
description: Rooms content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of rooms or apartments, each with a picture, the name, the guests or the size, a line, the price a night as it is shown and an optional address. One object is valid in every rooms layout (cards in three or two columns, rows).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.description: the rooms, in the order they are shown

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.description: address of the room picture; none: the placeholder

title.description: the name of the room (the alt text of the picture)

guests.description: the guests or the size as it is shown (2 guests, 24 m2); empty: none

description.description: one line about the room; empty: none

price.description: the price a night as it is shown

href.description: the address of the room page; empty: no link
